title: Coherent modules on a closed subscheme are the coherent modules annihilated by its ideal; the same for coherent formal modules
statement: Let $i:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] of locally Noetherian schemes [pqf-def-locnoeth] and $\mathcal J\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ its quasi-coherent ideal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. (1) The functor $i_*$ induces an equivalence between the category of coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-modules [pqf-def-coherent] and the full subcategory of the coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules $\mathcal F$ with $\mathcal J\mathcal F=0$; moreover $\operatorname{Supp}(i_*\mathcal G)=i(\operatorname{Supp}\mathcal G)$ [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. (2) Consequently, if $X$ is Noetherian and $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ is a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals, with $\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z$ its image in $\mathcal O_Z$, then $(\mathcal G_n)\mapsto(i_*\mathcal G_n)$ is an equivalence from $\mathit{Coh}(Z,\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z)$ onto the full subcategory of $\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$ of the objects supported on $Z$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and $i_*(\mathcal G^\wedge)\cong(i_*\mathcal G)^\wedge$ naturally in the coherent $\mathcal O_Z$-module $\mathcal G$ (as $i_*(\mathcal G/(\mathcal I\mathcal O_Z)^n\mathcal G)=i_*\mathcal G/\mathcal I^n i_*\mathcal G$).

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 087T (lemma-i-star-equivalence) for (1); (2) is the use of 087T 'without further mention' in the proofs of Lemma 088A (lemma-existence-tricky), Proposition 088C (proposition-existence-proper) and Theorem 088E (theorem-grothendieck-existence)
